name: librelink-mcp-rs
description: Read-only access to a LibreLinkUp follower account's glucose data, with honest freshness and coverage labels.
long_description: An unofficial, local MCP server for the LibreLinkUp follower API. Credentials are never entered here: run `librelink-mcp-rs setup` in a terminal first, which stores them in the OS credential store. Results are descriptive only, with no diagnosis or treatment advice. Validated on one configuration; see the compatibility notes.

tools.name: get_current_glucose
tools.description: Latest glucose reading with its source timestamp and freshness.

tools.name: get_glucose_history
tools.description: Readings in a window, oldest first, paged, with coverage and gaps.

tools.name: get_glucose_stats
tools.description: Sample and time-weighted statistics; GMI only when the window allows it.

tools.name: get_glucose_trends
tools.description: Observed range, trend arrow counts, and adjacent-point rates.

tools.name: get_sensor_info
tools.description: Masked sensor identifiers and source sensor fields.

tools.name: configure_credentials
tools.description: Explains local setup; accepts no secrets.

tools.name: validate_connection
tools.description: Reports data-source availability without glucose values.
